combination_policy.operands: load cases or other combinations: a term names a load case or a combination by kind; a subtraction's or range envelope's id names the load case when one has that id and a combination otherwise; the combination graph is acyclic and is evaluated in topological order, the earliest ready combination in the array first; a combination operand supplies its own published rows, paired by kind, unit, entity and every metadata field except basis and sign_convention, while still comparing any section_basis suffix within basis (a displacement magnitude by kind, unit and node); a row an operand combination withheld or omitted is missing for every combination that names it
combination_policy.fixed_load_count: each operand's fixed-load count κ, an exact dyadic rational: a load case 1; mechanics the exact sum of each factor times its operand's κ; a subtraction the minuend's minus the subtrahend's; a range envelope the operands' common κ, else undefined; an absolute sum or SRSS 0 when every operand's κ is exactly 0, else undefined; undefined with an undefined operand (a subtraction or envelope propagates it) or beyond 4,096 significand bits (COMBINATION_FIXED_LOAD_COUNT_UNREPRESENTABLE); over load cases, κ is the exact sum of the binary64 factors

operand_gate.condition: an operand combination is withheld; the combination is withheld whole, naming each withheld operand and its code

mechanics_gates.condition: the model has any nonlinear support record, including one inactive in every case, unless one term is a solved load case with factor exactly 1, at least one other term exists, and every other term is a combination whose κ is defined and exactly 0 (decision OQ-1), which is formed from rows as a solved state plus derived differences or bounds; not an equilibrium state
the model has a consuming constant-effort support and some operand's κ is undefined

the model has a consuming constant-effort support and the combination's own κ is undefined or |κ - 1| > 64*epsilon, compared exactly and not scaled by sum(|factors|); over load cases κ is the exact sum of the binary64 factors, and a non-finite factor leaves it undefined
the load cases the combination reaches through its operands, transitively, have different modulus-basis keys

unsigned_gates.condition: the model has a consuming constant-effort support and some operand's κ is undefined or not exactly 0
the load cases the combination reaches through its operands, transitively, have different modulus-basis keys

difference_basis_gates.condition: the subtraction declares difference_basis operating_minus_sustained and the subtrahend case's primitive loads, as a multiset by content (category, target, direction, dimension, and the magnitude's value bits and unit after the solve's own unit normalization, on the lowered model, so condition-generated primitives count; ids and provenance are not content), are not contained in the minuend case's: some content occurs more often in the subtrahend; equal final support states are not required
the subtraction declares difference_basis operating_minus_sustained and its two load cases have different modulus-basis keys
the minuend case has no converged nonlinear support state to lend
the minuend's converged state is not qualified (an inspectable unqualified gap state)
the minuend's state does not bind to this invocation, to its own receipt-bound solve, or to the subtrahend's model context and nonlinear supports one for one
a support held sliding has a different ground offset in the two cases
the held solve was refused, blocked or singular

combination_policy.gate_precedence: operand_gate first, then the first gate in list order of the combination's form supplies the single withheld reason; a result_state_subtraction declaring difference_basis operating_minus_sustained takes difference_basis_gates (its operands are load cases, so operand_gate never applies), and any other subtraction or range envelope is not gated; a minuend_final subtraction then takes the held-status gates in list order after G-2
combination_policy.result_state_subtraction: signed difference of solved states over linear_state_kinds, with recomputed magnitudes; no equilibrium claim; with difference_basis operating_minus_sustained (minuend and subtrahend load cases) its rows' sign convention reads "positive value follows explicit user result-state subtraction (minuend minus subtrahend) of matching source result sign conventions; operating minus sustained difference: a signed difference of two independently solved states, each using its own reported support state and carrying its own numerical standing under the static, history-free friction model; derived from case results; not an equilibrium state", their metadata basis is unchanged, and contract_evidence.difference_basis_derivation states both cases' primitive-content multisets; own behaves as absence; with subtrahend_support_state minuend_final the subtrahend is the subtrahend case's loads solved once with each nonlinear support held at the minuend's final status (a held-constraint comparison, which can need a reaction a unilateral support cannot supply and is not an admissible sustained state), published as rows of basis held_status_operand under the combination, never as the case's rows; its rows' sign convention reads "positive value follows explicit user result-state subtraction (minuend minus subtrahend) of matching source result sign conventions; operating minus sustained difference at the operating support status: the minuend case's own solved state minus the subtrahend case's loads solved with each nonlinear support held at the minuend's final status, a held-constraint comparison that can need a reaction a unilateral support cannot supply and is not an admissible sustained state, under the static, history-free friction model; derived from case results; not an equilibrium state" and contract_evidence.held_status_derivation states the held assignment, each support's decision and its inputs, any release, and the held standing
combination_policy.range_envelope: mode selection per row over linear_state_kinds and recomputed_magnitude_kinds; not a simultaneous state
combination_policy.absolute_sum: per row over linear_state_kinds, the exact sum of |factor × source value| rounded once to nearest, ties to even; recomputed magnitudes are the norm of the combined components, an upper bound on every signed combination's magnitude; rows are unsigned (basis explicit_user_absolute_sum; sign convention "unsigned value: the absolute sum of |factor × source result| over explicit user terms; not an equilibrium state"); a value, or a recomputed magnitude, outside the binary64 range is withheld as load-case algebra refused under LOAD_COMBINATION_ROW_WITHHELD (a support group whole); not an equilibrium state
combination_policy.srss: per row over linear_state_kinds, the square root of the exact sum of the squares of each factor × source value rounded once, the root rounded once to nearest, ties to even; recomputed magnitudes are the norm of the combined components, which equals the SRSS of the operands' magnitudes in exact arithmetic; rows are unsigned (basis explicit_user_srss; sign convention "unsigned value: the square root of the sum of squares of factor × source result over explicit user terms; not an equilibrium state"); a term or value, or a recomputed magnitude, outside the binary64 range is withheld as load-case algebra refused under LOAD_COMBINATION_ROW_WITHHELD (a support group whole); not an equilibrium state
combination_policy.held_status_operand: a row of the held system that a minuend_final subtraction subtracts, published under the combination; not a load case's result and not an admissible sustained state
combination_policy.never_combined: every other kind, including pipe_elastic_normal_stress_maximum_v2, component_equal_factor_intensified_bending_stress_v1, nonlinear support kinds, reviews, records, counts, codes and residuals

supported_profile_limitations: Small-displacement, linear-elastic frame preview: straight members, including geometry-only bends, are Timoshenko with the energy-matched annular shear factor (timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1) and Poisson's ratio E/(2G) - 1, and realized arcs are Euler-Bernoulli; a straight member's published nodal rotations are section rotations, not slopes; numerical integrity does not establish physical correctness.
Nonzero pressure is refused on this route.

On every member the section normal-stress extremes are N/A ± hypot(My,Mz)/Z at each station and the transverse shear maximum is the straight-annulus Saint-Venant value, with ν = E/(2G) − 1 assuming an isotropic material. On straight members the normal-stress maximum is |N/A| + hypot(My,Mz)/Z, bounded over all statics intervals. Torsional shear is separate. No equivalent stress or code stress.

On arcs: signed tangent-frame resultants, nominal stress components and section extremes; endpoint force rows are node-on-element actions in the tangent frame at their end. The normal-stress maximum is bounded along the arc and enters the stress headline. The transverse shear uses the straight-annulus field without curvature correction.

Intensified measures are i*hypot(My,Mz)/Z with the user's scalar SIF at member ends adjacent to markers and branches, using member Z. They are not code stresses and are never combined. A flexibility factor never multiplies stress. On realized arcs with directional SIFs, intensified bending is hypot(i_ip*Mz, i_op*My)/Z in the tangent frame, with its along-arc maximum.
Signed support actions for rigid restraints, springs, consuming constant effort and attributable nonlinear supports. Ambiguous attribution is withheld.

Headlines cover all load cases. In a model with nonlinear supports a mechanics combination is withheld unless one term is a solved load case with factor exactly 1, at least one other term exists, and every other term is a combination whose fixed-load count κ is defined and exactly 0; it is then formed from rows, with its operands' standing, as a solved state plus derived differences or bounds, not an equilibrium state. With a consuming constant effort a mechanics combination is withheld when its κ is undefined or differs from 1 by more than 64ε, and an absolute sum or SRSS unless every operand's κ is exactly 0. Mechanics combinations, absolute sums and SRSS are also withheld for mixed moduli over the load cases they reach, and every combination is withheld with a withheld operand combination. Absolute sums and SRSS are unsigned. Subtraction is a labelled difference. No combination maxima and no code compliance.

Member actions, section actions, stresses and support reactions of a load case reported NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_CHECKS_PASSED are recovered at 128-bit precision from the formation check's corrected displacement and rounded once; they are not binary64 recomputations from the solve's own displacement, from which they may differ by about 1e-12 of the body's action scale (at most about 6e-9 in the evaluation sets).

The recovery is checked against the formation check's re-formed system (stiffness and loads formed at 128-bit precision from the binary64 inputs). Wherever the formation check produced its member bound for a load case, including a case that the member recovery check then reports as sensitive, each published nodal displacement component is the corrected displacement (the solve's displacement plus the check's two correction terms, summed exactly) rounded once to binary64 in SI units and then converted to the published unit as every other row is, and each displacement magnitude is the correctly rounded norm of the node's three published translation components; where there is no such bound, or where any component of the case cannot be formed, every published displacement of the case is the solve's own, and a selected retained source publishes its recovery's nodal values. Support reactions balance the re-formed loads, not the solve's binary64 load vector.
